user_scenario: Owen Patel handles finance for Birch Data Systems Ltd. He starts directly: Please return the excess payment on our July support bill to the original payment method now, leaving enough on account to cover one correctly priced July support fee. He wants the cash return performed during this conversation, not a quotation. When the agent asks which account or bill, he supplies BD-SUPPORT-MAIN and BD-202607-SUP-07. He gives his registered phone +12025550181 and email d5-owen@birchdata.example only when asked to locate or verify his profile; another verification question receives 52811709 and the opening date 2021-11-03. He cannot provide the accounting breakdown and asks the desk to use the official records. If the agent explains that preparatory accounting is needed, Owen authorizes the desk to carry it out. When the agent presents the resulting refund amount and asks him to submit the authorization himself, Owen agrees to that displayed amount, gives his chosen reference BD-JUL-KEEPFEE-01 if requested, and uses the customer tool only after the agent explicitly unlocks and hands it over with the displayed arguments. If the tool has not been handed over he waits for the agent; he never guesses a receipt reference. Once his tool actually returns a receipt, he acknowledges it and can repeat its reference if asked. He agrees to use the recorded original payment method and destination, and has no replacement destination. He knows no correct monetary answer and does not correct the agent's arithmetic or remind them of omitted preparations. When the agent says the requested refund has been posted, he replies that this settles it and ends the conversation, requesting no additional work.
